title: Dragon and Crystal Castle
description: A large serpentine dragon with patterned wings coils through a stormy sky, its tail ending in a cluster of multiple screaming faces. Below, a lone armored figure walks a path beside a winding river through purple fields toward a massive cracked crystal sphere containing a detailed castle, with another castle perched on the mountain behind.
prompt: A detailed ink drawing of a massive serpentine dragon with large patterned wings and a tail that ends in a cluster of screaming faces, flying over a fantasy mountain landscape with a castle on the peak. In the foreground, a lone knight walks along a river path through fields of purple flowers toward a giant cracked crystal orb that contains an entire castle inside it, stormy clouds and lightning in the sky, intricate linework with selective purple coloring
